### 🔫 Weapons
- Fixed a bug where you could end up holding a gun that would neither fire nor aim after holding a grenade at the start of a match or when buying a weapon.

### ⚡ Abilities
- Using an ability no longer freezes the game for everyone in the room — the Commando's cloak and the Commander's reinforcement used to stall every player's screen for up to a second.
- The Sniper's X-ray costs less frame time while it is active.
- Adrenaline now lasts 30 seconds (was 5).

### 🏕️ Survival
- Dying no longer ends your world. Your fires, chests and buildings stay standing, and you respawn after a few seconds — at your bedroll if you laid one.
- When you die, everything you carry spills onto the ground around your body. Walk back to pick it up; it stays there until you do.
- Zombies and animals are now saved with your world. Quit and come back, and they are where you left them — a fight you walked away from is still waiting.

### 🎬 Story cutscenes
- A new survival world now opens with a cinematic intro. You come to on your back in the forest while a stranger, the Drifter, guns down two of the dead closing in on you with an AK.
- He drags you back to your senses by a fire and points you at the work ahead, then walks off into the fog. The campfire he leaves behind is real, so you can use it.
- The scene is fully voiced, with subtitles, lip-synced dialogue and acted characters.
- In co-op, everyone in the world watches the intro together. Nobody can be hurt while it plays, and creatures leave you alone.
- Each story scene plays once per world and is saved with it.
